meta.name: knowledge-distillation
meta.description: Compress large language models using knowledge distillation from teacher to student models. Use when deploying smaller models with retained performance, transferring GPT-4 capabilities to open-source models, or reducing inference costs. Covers temperature scaling, soft targets, reverse KLD, logit distillation, and MiniLLM training strategies.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用教师模型压缩学生模型，保留性能并降低推理成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把大模型能力迁移到小模型上部署
copy.tagline_en: Compress large models into smaller ones while retaining performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to deploy smaller models with retained performance from larger ones

howto.what: 装上技能后，Claude 能使用知识蒸馏技术将大型语言模型（如 70B）压缩为更小的模型（如 7B），保留 90% 以上的性能，降低推理成本。支持温度缩放、软目标、逆向 KLD、logit 蒸馏和 MiniLLM 训练策略。
howto.when: 当你需要将大型模型压缩为更小、更经济的版本时触发，例如将 70B 模型压缩为 7B，或将 GPT-4 的能力转移到开源模型上。

say.text: 使用知识蒸馏把 Llama-2-70B 压缩成 7B 模型。
say.note: Claude 会生成蒸馏训练代码。

say.text: 将 GPT-4 的知识蒸馏到 Mistral-7B 上。
say.note: Claude 会提供跨模型蒸馏方案。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can compress large language models (e.g., 70B) into smaller ones (e.g., 7B) using knowledge distillation, retaining 90%+ performance and reducing inference costs. Covers temperature scaling, soft targets, reverse KLD, logit distillation, and MiniLLM training strategies.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to compress a large model into a smaller, cost-effective version, such as reducing 70B to 7B, or transferring GPT-4 capabilities to an open-source model.

say_en.text: Distill Llama-2-70B knowledge down to a 7B model.
say_en.note: Claude will generate training code for distillation.

say_en.text: Transfer GPT-4's knowledge to Mistral-7B via distillation.
say_en.note: Claude will provide cross-model distillation steps.
